# United Nations

> > The official website of the United Nations, providing access to documentation, research resources, peacekeeping operations, and institutional information.

The UN site encompasses the Dag Hammarskjöld Library's research guides and digital collections, the Department of Peace Operations training resources, procurement services, and comprehensive documentation of Security Council proceedings, General Assembly resolutions, and member state information.

## Key Topics

- United Nations documentation
- Dag Hammarskjöld Library
- UN Digital Library
- Department of Peace Operations (DPO)
- Peacekeeping training and operations
- Security Council proceedings and vetoes
- General Assembly resolutions
- Integrated Training Service (ITS)
- Civilian Pre-Deployment Training (CPT)
- UN member states and founding members
- Index to Proceedings
- Linked Data Services
- Multilateral development banks
- UN official languages
- Ask DAG reference service

## Research & Documentation

- [Vetoes - UN Security Council Meetings & Outcomes Tables](https://research.un.org/en/docs/sc/quick): Security Council vetoes and meetings outcomes research guide
- [UN Founding Members](https://research.un.org/en/unmembers/founders): UN founding members reference guide from Dag Hammarskjöld Library

## Peacekeeping & Training

- [Training - Peacekeeping Resource Hub](https://peacekeepingresourcehub.un.org/en/training): DPO peacekeeping training resources for military, police, and civilians

## Procurement & Development Services

- [UN Development Business Phase Down](https://devbusiness.un.org/): UNDB procurement service closure notice for multilateral development banks

## Support & FAQs

- [What are the official languages of the United Nations?](https://ask.un.org/faq/14463): FAQ on UN official languages from Dag Hammarskjöld Library
